title: TagMappingMap
description: Renames tags on the target work item from a list of source → target pairs; tags that match no pair are kept unchanged.

ApplyTo.description: A list of Work Item Types that this Field Map will apply to. Use "*" to apply it to all Work Item Types. A field map with an empty list applies to no Work Item Types and never runs.

Enabled.description: Not used: every configured field map runs for the work item types in `ApplyTo`. To turn a field map off, remove it from `FieldMaps`.

mappings.description: The renames, applied in order; the first `source` that matches a tag wins.
